title: Simulation for Any Number of Steps
statement: Let $M$ be an $m$-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with state set $S$, and let $c$ be a configuration on a Boolean input word $y$. If $b$ satisfies the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position, then for every Boolean input word $x$, every virtual input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, every Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$, and every $t\in\mathbb N$, there is a Boolean tag $b'$ satisfying the boundary condition for the input-head position reached by $M$ after $t$ steps, such that the virtual simulation after $t$ steps is exactly the configuration built from that reached configuration, tag $b'$, the same position $p$, and the same list $\mathrm{pre}$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number and $S$ is a type
$M$ is an $m$-tape machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$y$ is a Boolean list and $c$ is a configuration on input $y$
$b$ is a Boolean tag satisfying the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position
$p$ is a position among the $|x|+2$ virtual input-head positions
